account: It is ten o'clock on day 0, and I am in the plaza for my scheduled market walk. Nothing I have seen yet establishes unusual business in town. Townsfolk 10, 20 and 30 all reported that the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery. That seems consistent with making bread; I have no evidence of another purpose, and their repeated reports may simply be shared news rather than independent observations. At the office, the secretary said there was no correspondence or report of unusual business and that the appointments chest was empty, although I had returned the appointment book there. I subsequently saw the secretary take a written book from that chest. This is a discrepancy worth clarifying, but could be a timing or communication mistake rather than concealment. I recited today's engagements and asked who my dockside tea host is, but left before I could make out the secretary's reply. My remaining appointments are lunch at home at noon, office accounts at one, dockside tea at three, office at four thirty, and home at seven. I still want to learn whether anything is happening without my knowledge, but currently have no identified secret activity, participants, or purpose.
